Closes #70482 

Fixes grammar in the hints of the "Build an RPG Character" lab:

- Added a comma after each opening "When ..." clause
- Added serial commas in "second, third, or fourth" and "second, third, and fourth"
- Fixed the sum hint so it uses the plural "arguments that do not sum to 7"

Only the hint text changed. The tests and solution are untouched.
